summary.text: Victoria Kornfield, also known as Tori, is the Democratic candidate for the Maine House of Representatives, District 23, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in a race with no incumbent against Republican Brian Ames.
She previously represented District 125 in the Maine House from 2012 to 2020 and worked as an educator at Bangor High School.

paragraphs.text: Victoria Kornfield earned a master's degree in teaching and a certificate of advanced study in educational administration from the University of Maine at Orono, and Ballotpedia lists her career experience as working as an educator with Bangor High School.
As of April 2020 she lived in Bangor.
Kornfield assumed office in the Maine House of Representatives, representing District 125, on December 4, 2012, and left office on December 1, 2020.
She chaired the Education and Cultural Affairs Committee in the 2015, 2017 and 2019-2020 sessions.
Ballotpedia's campaign finance records show she lost the 2020 primary for Maine State Senate District 9 instead of seeking re-election to the House.
